cs.t: If you don't want to go full-blown Home Assistant or anything "smart", you can still handle this with a self-contained switch. I installed a Honeywell similar to this one [1]. You tell it the date and your lat/long, and it knows the times for dawn and dusk. I had a previous version of it 10 years ago [2]. Worked great. [1]  https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004AP92N2/  [2]  https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004SOZHXY/
